verdict.rationale: Reflect supports a few multi-item actions. You can bulk import from Apple Notes, Evernote, Markdown, Roam and Workflowy, and export to HTML or Markdown. You can also filter notes and then use AI chat across that filtered set, but this is read-only Q&A, not an operation that changes the notes. There is no evidence of bulk edit, tag, move or delete, and the API is limited to appending and creating single notes; because notes are end-to-end encrypted, the API cannot read them, so it cannot script bulk changes. Missing for 10: bulk edit/tag/move/delete of selected notes, AI actions applied across many notes, bulk-capable API endpoints, hands-on corroboration.
